Thanks Elena — copying Marissa and Vivek to pull the evidence together. Quick notes for the committee while we assemble the packet:

- Latency P95 score: final score reflects a 22% improvement versus Q1 baseline after we deployed the KV-cache tuning (v2.3 runtime) on 2027-04-12. We excluded two cross-region outage windows (2027-05-08 02:00–03:15 UTC and 2027-05-23 18:20–18:50 UTC) that were tied to an infra provider networking flap; those are documented in incident IDs RH-20270508-12 and RH-20270523-07.

- Signals used: production telemetry (P95 token latency by model family), synthetic canary results (steady-state 1k reqs/min), and customer error-rate correlated to latency. I've included the precise query IDs in the evidence packet.

Marissa: can you attach the Q2 evidence snapshot (score->artifact mapping) and the latest score spreadsheet? Vivek: any concerns about the exclusions or language for the committee?

I'll follow up with a short narrative for the QBR and a digest that Acme's committee can attach to the renewal memo.

Thanks,
Karthik
